summary: A Depth 20 subscription on NSE: the book goes to Dhan's twentydepth socket and the quote to the market feed; a book made of both halves before any quote has no quote fields, and the next one carries the quote that came meanwhile.

notes: Worked by hand from dhan_websocket.py:889-912 (20 rows of f64 price, u32 quantity, u32 orders; code 41 bids, 51 asks) and dhan_adapter.py:791-859 (each half kept until the other comes, then one DEPTH publish).

deviations.reason: A depth frame keeps ltp, which the SDK's Depth callback reads: 0 before the instrument's first quote, its last traded price after; the web's 20-level frame has no ltp.

The desktop sends the sum of the 20 visible bid quantities as the total buy quantity; Dhan's 20-level packet carries no total and the web sends none. A sum of the visible levels is not the exchange's total.

Whether and how a frame carries ltt (in LTP frames, or beside the broker's own trade-time name) follows the web's Dhan adapter; the desktop always sends ltt in ms. Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).

The desktop's depth frame carries the instrument's latest quote from the market feed (feed::bridge::depth_update), as the web's Fyers adapter borrows it (openalgo#2318); the web's Dhan 20-level frame carries the book alone.
